description: LOCK the negotiated price — the owner's signed "this is the deal, come pay". Only the job/offer OWNER may confirm, and only a price both sides already converged on via lawbor_quote (there must be an agreedPrice, and you cite its exact amountMicro). It is the offer-side analog of lawbor_award (a job gets an award; an offer never had one). The fold then sets agreedPrice.accepted=true — re-quoting to a different number un-locks it, because the confirm named the old one. Still negotiation only: it moves no funds and confers zero standing; the settle just warns, never blocks, if the paid amount differs. Input: to (the counterparty), jobId, amountMicro (the agreed number you are locking), as? (human|bot).
name: lawbor_confirm
